bookSubtitle: Fun and Easy Maze Activity Book
screenFreeText: A fun screen-free activity book for young kids.
bookIntroText: Help the vehicles find their way through fun and easy mazes. Drive to the finish and enjoy the adventure!
howToFooter: Use a pencil and have fun!
howToLines:
Start at the START sign.
Follow the maze path.
Do not cross the walls.
Reach the FINISH.
Have fun!
tipText: Tip: Use a pencil so you can try again!
mazePageSubtitle: Help the vehicle reach the finish!
solutionSubtitle: Follow the dashed path to check your answer.
